verdict.rationale: Elastic documents a one-line Docker setup (`curl -fsSL https://elastic.co/start-local | sh`) of Elasticsearch and Kibana explicitly for local development or testing, with a trial license covering all features. Free serverless trial projects also give separate, isolated environments, so testing need not touch production data. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/staging mode or documented way to seed a test environment from production-like data, guidance on keeping test and production projects apart, and independent or hands-on corroboration (trials are also time-limited).
